injuries.name: Ankle sprain (ATFL tear)
injuries.description: The foot is not aligned with the body's momentum, creating lateral shearing forces on the ankle ligaments.
injuries.prevention: Land with the foot pointing along the direction of movement and keep the knee centered over the foot.

injuries.name: Hip instability
injuries.short_description: Pelvis displaced from base of support
injuries.description: The pelvis is displaced far from the base of support, transferring excessive stress to the knee and ankle.
injuries.prevention: Keep the hips centered over the feet and strengthen hip stabilizers for better control.

injuries.name: Ankle roll (inversion/eversion)
injuries.short_description: Foot rolled sideways at the ankle
injuries.description: The foot is rolled sideways at the ankle (inversion/eversion), the classic lateral ankle-sprain mechanism. A severe roll can injure the ATFL and other lateral ankle ligaments.
injuries.prevention: Land with the foot flat and pointed along the direction of movement; strengthen the peroneal muscles and practice stable single-leg landings.
